tldr: Pluto through the 7th house intensifies partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When Pluto moves through your 7th house, it brings pressure to partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

Something may no longer stay buried, controlled, avoided, or handled only on the surface. It can help you face the deeper truth and stop spending energy protecting a false version of peace.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for trying to control the outcome so tightly that you cannot tell what is changing naturally. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

Pluto moves through this house for a long chapter. Work with the deeper truth instead of forcing everything back into the old shape.
